agp_dha.title: Audit Report on District Health Authorities of Punjab (South), Audit Year 2024-25

evidence.text: Census 2023 reports Multan District total literacy at 61.41%, male literacy at 67.28%, female literacy at 55.27%, and 475,376 out-of-school children aged 5-16.
The audit report's Annexure-B lists 82 government dispensaries, 3 BHUs, 8 RHCs, 2 THQ hospitals, 2 DHQ hospitals and 1 DHDC for Multan DHA.
For FY 2023-24, Multan DHA's total budget lapse was 15.75% and its development budget lapse was 74.67%. Six of 22 formations were audited.
Census 2023 reports Bahawalpur District total literacy at 53.35%, male literacy at 59.40%, female literacy at 47.09%, and 487,764 out-of-school children aged 5-16.
The audit report's Annexure-B lists 74 government dispensaries, 58 BHUs, 13 RHCs, 4 THQ hospitals, no DHQ hospital and 1 DHDC for Bahawalpur DHA.
For FY 2023-24, Bahawalpur DHA's total budget lapse was reported as 0.01% and its development budget lapse as 0.00%. Six of 28 formations were audited.
